cases.title: Pursuit and Warrant

candidateTracks.title: Pursuit
candidateTracks.definition: The durable identity of an intended reality change across revisions, actors, actions, and evidence.
candidateTracks.claimBoundary: This track does not establish that Pursuit is the final name, a universal work ontology, historically novel, product-ready, or an accepted Primitive.

candidateTracks.title: Warrant
candidateTracks.definition: A purpose-bound, fact-addressed authorization for bounded continuation.
candidateTracks.claimBoundary: This track does not establish that Warrant is the final name, replaces enforcement or existing authorization systems, is universally valid, historically novel, product-ready, or an accepted Primitive.

cases.claimBoundary: This case preserves the fused Proof-Carrying Work Object genesis and tracks provisional Pursuit and Warrant candidates. It does not establish novelty, universality, product readiness, method superiority, or accepted Primitive status for either track.

cases.title: Initiative, Assignment, and Project Cut

candidateTracks.title: Initiative
candidateTracks.definition: An independently addressable context for continuing coordinated software work across participants, Pursuits, Assignments, decisions, lineage, and settlement.
candidateTracks.claimBoundary: Accepted only as a software-development Domain Profile Primitive under current KFD-12; the immutable cut retains its earlier KFD-11 coordinate. Cross-domain vocabulary, historical novelty, universal minimum fields, and KFD-12 activation are not claimed.

candidateTracks.title: Assignment
candidateTracks.definition: An independently addressable bounded software-work responsibility proposed to, accepted by, or held by a participant under declared context, authority, evidence, and settlement conditions.
candidateTracks.claimBoundary: Accepted only as a software-development Domain Profile Primitive under current KFD-12; the immutable cut retains its earlier KFD-11 coordinate. Universal task vocabulary, one actor model, historical novelty, and KFD-12 activation are not claimed.

candidateTracks.title: Project Cut
candidateTracks.definition: A software-project settlement object that publishes what a project officially became by binding independent source, Atlas, Episode, policy, and predecessor authorities without absorbing them.
candidateTracks.claimBoundary: Accepted only as a software-project settlement Primitive under current KFD-13; the immutable cut retains its earlier KFD-12 coordinate. It is not a fourth fact engine, a peer action coordinate, a universal domain object, proof of historical novelty, or activation of KFD-13.

cases.claimBoundary: This case records two perspective transformations and three bounded KFD-5 acceptances. It does not establish cross-domain universality, historical novelty, one physical implementation, or activation of the current draft KFD-12 and KFD-13 decisions. Immutable cuts retain their prerelease coordinates and map forward through the 2026-07-21 Foundation Revision.

cases.title: Consequential Settlement

candidateTracks.title: Consequential Settlement
candidateTracks.definition: A cross-domain procedure that preserves Claim, purpose-bound Assessment, Warrant-bound Decision, and independently recorded Admission as distinct responsibilities before successor Fact publication.
candidateTracks.claimBoundary: Provisional under draft KFD-11. The successor cut records Agent generation of the intermediate ontology through retained private transcript evidence and a dated public implementation sequence; it does not activate KFD-11, prove universal minimality or novelty, require four physical objects, or establish independent cross-domain adoption.

cases.claimBoundary: This case preserves the distributed Agent-led development, KFD-4 perspective replay, and provisional KFD-5 qualification of the Consequential Settlement procedure. Private attribution evidence and public Git chronology remain separate, and cross-domain activation is not claimed.

cases.title: Federated Work Continuity

candidateTracks.title: Work
candidateTracks.definition: A possible higher-layer, perspective-bound coordinated action whole that preserves component authority, cuts, typed relations, proof state, degradation, and the current action frontier across workspaces.
candidateTracks.claimBoundary: Provisional only. The successor cut binds current founding-product Work Control and experimental Primitive Catalog evidence while leaving independent entity, derived view, Initiative, Portfolio, Profile vocabulary, and no-new-Primitive outcomes unresolved; comparative dogfood, transfer, and independent review remain open.

cases.claimBoundary: This case preserves the Work hypothesis, its first cut, and a lineage-bound successor under current implementation pressure. It does not allocate a KFD number, qualify Work, claim cross-domain transfer, or create global fact authority.

cases.title: Product Release Cut and Cut Transition

candidateTracks.title: Product Release Cut
candidateTracks.definition: A possible product-domain Primitive or KFD-13 specialization that identifies one exact qualified product world while preserving source, artifact, signing, qualification, platform, and trust-domain authorities.
candidateTracks.claimBoundary: Provisional only. Project Cut specialization, release passport, manifest, SemVer plus artifact digest, and no-new-Primitive outcomes remain live; independent adoption, transfer, numbering, and release qualification are not claimed.

candidateTracks.title: Cut Transition
candidateTracks.definition: A possible product-domain Primitive or typed authority relation that binds exact endpoint Cuts, compatibility, migration, rollback, trust, and evidence for movement without absorbing endpoint identity or action execution.
candidateTracks.claimBoundary: Provisional only. Warrant-bound Decision plus Admission, typed upgrade-manifest relation, SemVer and channel precedence, and no-new-Primitive outcomes remain live; independent adoption, transfer, numbering, and movement authority are not claimed.

cases.claimBoundary: This case preserves two independently provisional tracks from one founding-adopter implementation cut. It does not accept either candidate, activate KFD-13, certify a product release, make Kungfu vocabulary universal, or prevent a no-new-Primitive decision.

cases.title: Recursive normative self-conformance

candidateTracks.title: Recursive normative self-conformance
candidateTracks.definition: A proposed procedure requiring a normative system's load-bearing self-change to traverse exact-root genesis, fact-bound qualification, independent review, authority-separated disposition, and explicit admission or retained non-promotion.
candidateTracks.claimBoundary: The independently reviewed cut records no-new-primitive for KFD-5 and no-new-kfd for the Candidate. It preserves the useful procedure as explicit composition but allocates no number and changes no numbered KFD.

cases.claimBoundary: This closed case retains the no-new-kfd result and its reopening conditions. It does not infer historical Profile conformance, allocate a number, activate a KFD, certify the Profile, or authorize release.

cases.title: Durable Result Identity and Availability Separation

candidateTracks.title: Durable Result Identity and Availability Separation
candidateTracks.definition: A possible cross-domain principle requiring reusable durable results to keep immutable identity, retention commitment, observed availability, transport coordinates, qualification, and reuse assessment independently addressable.
candidateTracks.claimBoundary: Provisional only. The founding Buildchain cut is first-party and shadow-only; existing KFD composition, a Buildchain Domain Profile, mature cache/provenance mechanisms, and no-new-Primitive outcomes remain live.

cases.claimBoundary: This case preserves one exact product-generated hypothesis and its unresolved alternatives. It does not allocate a KFD number, make Stage Capsule normative, qualify cross-domain transfer, certify Buildchain v4, or enable production reuse.
